name: Espresso Grab & Go
address: Level 0, AX ODYCY Hotel, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta.
price range: July 2025 menu examples: tea €1.85; espresso €1.95; sandwiches about €4.50–€6.95; salads about €6.95–€9.50. Prices may have changed.
description: The easiest coffee, juice, snack or light-meal option at the hotel, including when you return late. The official menu includes hot drinks, sandwiches, salads, fruit and cakes.
notes: The official AX page says open 24/7 and provides a July 2025 menu PDF with prices including VAT. Menu PDF: https://axhotelsmalta.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Espresso-Menu.pdf · Ask the hotel if your concern is building-specific water or food/allergen handling.

name: Trattoria Riccardo
address: Level -1, AX ODYCY Hotel, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta.
hours: Official contact page lists Monday–Sunday 12:00–22:30; confirm on the day and reserve if needed.
price range: Current March 2026 food menu examples: tomato pasta €9.75; listed pasta dishes €14.50–€17.50; selected mains €23.50–€29.50. Check the full current menu; drinks/desserts are additional.
description: A convenient Italian dinner at the hotel, with a wood-fired oven, fresh pasta, seafood and a family play area. The published menu includes vegetarian choices; the same-kitchen allergen warning means guests with allergies should speak with staff before ordering.
notes: Official contact page lists hours, Level -1 address and phone +356 2354 3543. Current food menu PDF: https://trattoriariccardo.mt/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Trattoria-Riccardo-Menu.pdf · Reservation: https://app.tableo.com/widget/trattoria-riccardo-malta · TripAdvisor UK search-result snippets include dated Aug 2026 comments about food, sea views and service; individual reviewers are not a substitute for an independent quality check: https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Restaurant_Review-g608947-d26887189-Reviews-Trattoria_Riccardo-Qawra_Island_of_Malta.html

name: Minoa Mediterranean Fusion
address: AX ODYCY Hotel, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta; the hotel is identified as Minoa's location, but the separate Minoa page does not publish a street-number address.
hours: Wednesday–Saturday 18:30–22:30; closed Sunday–Tuesday according to AX's indexed venue listing. Minoa says ages 16+.
price range: Official menu: à-la-carte starters €16–€20, mains €22–€36, desserts €9; tasting menus €70 vegetarian / €80 regular / €95 signature per guest. Check the live menu and booking terms.
description: A special-occasion, rooftop Mediterranean-fusion option with views. It is the highest-price venue in this short list; the current menu includes separate vegetarian tasting and à-la-carte dishes. The entire table must order a tasting menu by 20:30.
notes: Official Minoa page lists Wednesday–Saturday dinner, 18:30–22:30 and 16+ access. Live menu: https://minoa.mt/restaurant-menu/ · booking: https://minoa.mt/book-a-table/ · AX indexed venue page lists the same hours: https://axhotelsmalta.com/odycy/qawra-restaurants/minoa/ . name: Cheeky Monkey Gastropub Qawra
area: Qawra Coast Road, beside AX ODYCY
address: Qawra Coast Road, Qawra, Malta. Official phone: +356 7954 3853.
hours: Daily. Sunday–Thursday 12:00–00:00; Friday–Saturday 12:00–01:00. Last food order 22:30. Happy hour daily 16:00–19:00 (check current offer).
price range: Official July 2025 menu examples: sharing bites €8.25–€11.50, sandwiches €12.25–€13.75, burgers €15.45–€21.95, mains €20.95–€26.50; kids' meals €7. Menu may change.
description: A lively, convenient gastropub for burgers, sandwiches, sharing plates and cocktails next to the hotel. The official site describes the daily 16:00–19:00 happy hour. Its 2025 menu warns that cross-contamination with nuts/gluten may occur; discuss allergies directly with staff.
notes: Hours, location, phone and current linked menus are on the official Qawra page. Food menu (dated July 2025): https://cheekymonkeymalta.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Cheeky-Monkey-Qawra-Food-Menu.pdf · drinks menu: https://cheekymonkeymalta.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Cheeky-Monkey-Qawra-Beverage-Menu.pdf · TripAdvisor UK search result showed 4.5/5 and 3,203 reviews; U.S. snippets showed different counts.
